text:
niko: Heads-up: saw p99 spike on /v1/notify in ap-south at 07:46 but p50/p95 stayed normal. anyone digging?

jamal: I pulled minute buckets. looks like a tiny sample cluster on instance=inst-7. 07:46 has n=11 for that instance.

tara: query I ran: ```SELECT minute, instance, percentile(99,latency_ms) AS p99, percentile(95,latency_ms) AS p95, count(*) AS n FROM traces WHERE endpoint='/v1/notify' AND region='ap-south' AND minute BETWEEN '2026-03-10T07:40:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T07:50:00Z' GROUP BY minute, instance;```

jamal: results snippet: 07:45 inst-7 p95=210 p99=212 n=95 
07:46 inst-7 p95=218 p99=1985 n=11 
07:46 inst-3 p95=212 p99=220 n=400

siobhan: low-n burst. tdigest rollup noise likely. we should show samplecount inline in the latency card and surface a one-click exact compute for the minute (hits /raw-agg).

niko: Agree. UX suggestion: next to each percentile show "(n=...)" and if n<50 show a pale yellow pill "low samples" and an "exact" button that fetches raw values. Also overlay rollout/route weights on the sparkline so weight flips are obvious.

jamal: backend has /raw-agg; will add a perf guard for wide spans. I'll prototype frontend badge+exact toggle. target: small PR this week.

siobhan: I'll run a quick sim comparing tdigest vs raw for p99 at n in [5,10,20,50] and post divergence numbers. if divergence > 20% at n<20 we should auto-prefer raw for that minute.

tara: can we also show retry fraction? e.g. "p99 1985ms (n=11, r=4) low samples". retries + low samples = red flag.

console-bot: created ticket CON-2099 "Latency: inline samplecount, low-sample advisory, exact-minute aggregate toggle, weight overlay" assigned to eng-platform backlog.

niko: thanks folks. action items: jamal frontend + perf guard, siobhan sims, tara add retry flag in query. we'll demo in next sync.
